title: Equity Brief — 01 Sep 2026
intro: Risk-off sentiment dominates the Europe-NY crossover session with broad-based weakness across global equities, though VIX at 15.65 signals controlled retreat rather than panic. European indices lead declines while US mega-cap tech shows divergence, with Apple rallying 2.42% offsetting weakness in Amazon and Tesla.

sections.heading: 📈 EQUITY SUMMARY
sections.content: Risk-off sentiment dominates the Europe-NY crossover session with broad-based weakness across global equities, though VIX at 15.65 signals controlled retreat rather than panic. European indices lead declines while US mega-cap tech shows divergence, with Apple rallying 2.42% offsetting weakness in Amazon and Tesla.

sections.heading: 🌍 INDEX RANKING
sections.content:
Nikkei 225: 66,215 -0.15% — Outperformer on yen stability, minimal impact from global selloff
S&P 500: 5,763.46 -0.47% — Defensive positioning ahead of September seasonality
FTSE 100: 10,794 -0.28% — Energy and commodity exposure providing support
CAC 40: 8,308 -0.32% — Luxury goods sector drag offsetting industrial strength
Hang Seng: 25,330 -0.93% — China property concerns weighing on sentiment
DAX: 25,994 -1.01% — Weakest major index on auto sector softness
🇺🇸 US MARKET
S&P 500 at 5,763.46 testing 5,750 support level, bias neutral-to-bearish if breaks; Russell 2000 underperformance at -2.36% weekly signals small-cap rotation concerns.
Nasdaq 26,137 holding above 26,000 psychological support despite -0.89% session loss; weekly flat at +0.03% shows resilience in tech infrastructure plays.
Dow 53,128 showing relative strength at -0.11% as defensive rotation favors industrials and healthcare over growth sectors.
🇪🇺 EUROPE
DAX 25,994 -1.01% leading European declines on weak German manufacturing data and auto supplier warnings.
FTSE 100 10,794 -0.28% outperforming continental peers on energy majors absorbing oil price bounce.
CAC 40 8,308 -0.32% pressured by LVMH weakness following Asia luxury demand concerns.
💻 TECH FOCUS
Apple 324.52 +2.42% surging on iPhone 18 pre-order data exceeding analyst expectations, bucking broader tech weakness.
Amazon 253.99 -2.22% under pressure from profit-taking after strong August rally and logistics cost inflation fears.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: Apple 324.50 entry on AI device cycle momentum, stop 318.00, target 335.00
LONG: FTSE 100 10,800 entry on energy sector stability, stop 10,650, target 11,100
SHORT/AVOID: Russell 2000 2,935 — small-cap credit spread widening and deteriorating breadth signal further downside to 2,850

sections.heading: ⚠️ RISKS
sections.content: September seasonality historically weakest month for equities with average S&P decline of 0.7% creating headwind through month
